subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: For Google Chat Spaces that are already delivered to the HTTP endpoint, should OpenClaw preserve strict annotation-based mention gating, broaden mention detection, or treat delivered Space events as addressed by default for this plugin?
rationale: The remaining failure sits on an access-policy boundary: preserving strict mention checks may keep a live silent-drop path, while relaxing them changes which Space messages can trigger agents.

options.title: Broaden Mention Detection And Diagnostics
options.body: Preserve the mention-gated default, but accept current Google Chat annotation shapes, add focused diagnostics, and require live proof that @mentions create group sessions.

options.title: Treat Delivered Space Events As Addressed
options.body: Make Google Chat HTTP endpoint Space events bypass local mention detection when Google has already delivered them, accepting a broader behavior change for this plugin.

options.title: Consolidate Into Broader Space Routing
options.body: Move the remaining work into the broader Google Chat Space/threading tracker only after preserving this issue's v2026.6.11 mention-gating evidence there.

recommendation.title: Broaden Mention Detection And Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Preserve the mention-gated default, but accept current Google Chat annotation shapes, add focused diagnostics, and require live proof that @mentions create group sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history signal across the shared mention gate and Google Chat access-policy code that defines this product boundary.
